B='agent-browser --session cc6ebacde2ec__board'
S=/tmp/observatory-m3-ut/rt2/board
E=/Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c/evidence/m3/rt2-board
: > $S/board-039-card-names.txt
while read id at kind lane; do
  $B fill '[aria-label="scrubber-time"]' "$at" >/dev/null && $B press Tab >/dev/null
  sleep 0.5
  fid=$(grep "^$id|" $S/board-039-oracle-pairs.txt | cut -d'|' -f2)
  pre=$(echo $id | cut -c1-8)
  line=$($B eval --stdin < /tmp/observatory-m3-ut/r2/browser/cards.js | jq -r 'fromjson[]' | grep "\[$pre\]" | head -1)
  ok=no; echo "$line" | grep -q "now: [a-z_]* [^ ]* $fid \[$pre\]" && ok=yes
  echo "$id $fid $at ok=$ok :: $line" >> $S/board-039-card-names.txt
  if [ "$pre" = "2c04bd42" ]; then $B eval "document.querySelector('article[aria-label=card-m0]').scrollIntoView({block:'center'});1" >/dev/null; $B screenshot $E/board-039-card-m0-feature-id-name.png; fi
  if [ "$pre" = "ca58108e" ]; then $B eval "document.querySelector('article[aria-label=card-s]').scrollIntoView({block:'center'});1" >/dev/null; $B screenshot $E/board-039-card-s-feature-id-name.png; fi
done < $S/card-times.txt
cat $S/board-039-card-names.txt
echo "ok=yes count: $(grep -c 'ok=yes' $S/board-039-card-names.txt)"
summary: Scrub to each oracle session and read cards
